thread.title: Apple's upcoming capital return announcement not a reason to be bullish: analyst - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple's upcoming capital return announcement not a reason to be bullish: analyst - MarketWatch
text: Analysts at Raymond James resumed coverage of Apple Inc. AAPL, +3.36% Friday with a market perform rating, citing the stock's big run up prior to "a supercycle that didn't occur" as reason for their mixed stance. The analysts, led by Chris Caso, see Apple's upcoming spring announcement about how it plans to grow its capital returns program as the next potential catalyst for the stock, but they believe that with so many people anticipating this update, it's not "enough of a reason to be overweight the stock." Later this year, the analysts believe that Apple could benefit from doing a better job of managing "the mix of features and price points" given what they perceive as "substantial demand" already for phones that cost $1,000 or more. Apple shares are down 0.2% in premarket trading Friday and up 28% over the past 12 months, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +1.23% up 22% in that time.
